Poli-Flex Turbo is a polyurethane transfer film equipped with a special hotmelt for fast application at low temperature.
With super-fast heat pressing times as little as 3 seconds, the Poli-Flex® Turbo is recognised as being the best in class when it comes to coloured HTV.

This super soft PU film can be used on a variety of textiles such as cotton, polyester and blended fabrics such as polyester / acrylic as well as uncoated nylon. Also suitable for smooth wood, leather, cardboard and glass. With its brilliant level of stretch, this range is also perfect for leisure and activewear but the special thing about all products in the Turbo range is the speed and temperature of heat pressing. Garments used for team sports are either made of 100% polyester or they contain a high polyester content and blended with cotton, nylon or lycra. This means that they are sensitive to heat and prone to dye migration.
Therefore choosing the correct heat transfer vinyl is important and making sure that it has dye blocking capabilities is crucial to a successful print.

Image Flex Turbo Print Sub Block 4010 is the perfect product for use on team sportswear as it has the added bonus of a sublimation resistant blockout layer to prevent colour migration of polyester fabrics showing through the printed image

column1: Want to know what makes this different to Static Cling?
Static Cling Vinyl is completely free of adhesive. It is the static electrical charge within the film that attracts (clings) it to a surface that has an opposite charge.

Our Glue Free Adhesion films work in a completely different way using something called 'van der Waals force'. The surface of these films comprise of a microporous layer of carbon nanotubes that expand the surface area of the film and gives it a grip like feel. When the film is applied to a smooth surface this layer aligns itself to the surface forming a strong 'grip' but when peeled off at an angle this grip is broken

Seal_It_Pen,"Total Seal Pen","SEA2","iSEE2","320","14","DEFAULT","","","","","0","Total Seal is a fast and easy solution to edge sealing problems with vinyl applications. Total Seal consists of a clear acrylic lacquer containing UV blocking agents, which drys in approximately 10 minutes after application.

Total Seal is a fast and easy edge sealing solution for self-adhesive vinyl and metallised films that require protection from lifting, which may be caused by environmental exposure, cleaning or excessive contact.
The clear acrylic lacquer contains UV blocking agents and is dispensed in a handy felt tipped pen nib which drys in approximately 10 minutes after application - No waste, No mess.
Total Seal lacquer is compatible with all types of vinyl graphics and metallised films.
This method of edge sealing is particularly recommended to protect semi rigid films such as Metallised Polyesters and Holographic Films.
For professional, commercial and industrial use only. Contains mineral spirits and I-Methoxy-2-Propanyl Acetate. Liquid and vapour can be harmful or fatal if swallowed.
Use in a well ventilated area.
